title: Prevent approval from overriding policy denial
goal: Ensure user approval can only satisfy a policy-approved action's additional approval requirement and never override an explicit policy denial.
context: M6 initializes allowed from PolicyDecision.allowed but unconditionally replaces it with ApprovalGate's result whenever requiresApproval is true. A contradictory decision with allowed=false and requiresApproval=true can therefore execute when the gate returns true.
forbidden_changes: Do not let approval change a policy denial into an allow.
Do not invoke the approval gate for an action already denied by policy.
Do not weaken normal approval requirements for policy-approved actions.
acceptance_criteria: A policy decision with allowed=false and requiresApproval=true remains denied.
The approval gate is not called for a policy-denied action.
The goal is aborted, the denial reason is preserved, and no actionExecuted event is emitted.
Normal policy-approved actions requiring approval still use the gate.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Gate the approval branch on both requiresApproval and decision.allowed; add a regression where a permissive gate must not reverse explicit policy denial.
